beat: Saturday Chotu delivery: withdrawal, visible tears and first explanation

lines.original: Absentmindedly, she kept stroking Pappu's hair who was lying on her lap and drinking milk from her breasts. After seeing Chotu in the store last time and both smiling at each other, she didn't see him at all....There were a few items which she couldn't get in the super store, which she thought she will order from Maami and ask her to have it delivered by Chotu...
lines.local: Anmane mann se Dhika apni godi mein dudh pee rahe Pappu ke baal sahla rahi thi. Store par pichhli baar Chotu se muskuraakar milne ke baad phir usse nahi mili thi. Supermarket mein kuch cheezein nahi mili thi, isliye Maami se order karke Chotu se delivery karwane ka socha.

lines.original: After drinking milk... Pappu was playing with his toys while John and Dhika had breakfast...
lines.local: Doodh peene ke baad Pappu toys se khelne laga, aur John aur Dhika ne breakfast kiya.

lines.original: Around 11 AM..... John went out for some errands... and Pappu fell asleep on the sofa... Dhika took him and put him on her bed and came out...
lines.local: Takreeban 11 baje John kuch kaam se bahar gaya. Pappu sofa par so gaya toh Dhika ne use bedroom mein sula diya aur wapas aayi.

lines.original: She decided to call Maami and order those items...but mainly she wanted to see Chotu.....
lines.local: Usne Maami ko samaan order karne ke liye call karne ka faisla kiya; asal mein woh Chotu se milna chahti thi.

lines.original: It was about 30 minutes after she placed the order..... she heard the door bell.....
lines.local: Order ke lagbhag aadhe ghante baad doorbell baji.

lines.original: Ding Dong........
lines.local: Ding dong...

lines.original: Chotu: didi... he knocked the door.....
lines.local: Chotu ne darwaza knock karke kaha: Didi!

lines.original: Dhika: Running towards the door... she held it open for him... smiling....
lines.local: Dhika daudkar darwaze par pahunchi, use kholkar muskuraayi.

lines.original: Chotu gave her an awkward smile and went inside and quietly started unpacking the things.....
lines.local: Chotu ne awkward smile di, andar aaya aur chupchaap samaan kholne laga.

lines.original: Dhika felt Chotu was looking very dull and silently kept observing him.....
lines.local: Dhika ko woh bahut dull laga; woh chupchaap use observe karti rahi.

lines.original: Chotu was very busy unpacking...he didn't once turn his head up and look at her..... Dhika felt sad....
lines.local: Chotu samaan nikaalne mein laga raha; ek baar bhi sir uthakar Dhika ko nahi dekha. Use bura laga.

lines.original: Dhika: Chotuuuu..... she called him pouting her lips...
lines.local: Dhika: Chotuuu... woh hont phulaakar bulaane lagi.

lines.original: Chotu: without raising his head... quietly, Haan didi......
lines.local: Chotu ne sir uthaye bina dheere se kaha: Haan didi.

lines.original: Dhika: Sir won't even look at me now ? she said in a little anger
lines.local: Dhika thoda gusse mein: Janab ab meri taraf dekhenge bhi nahi?

lines.original: When Chotu raised his face to look at her...... she felt struck...
lines.local: Chotu ne chehra uthaya toh Dhika ekdam tham gayi.

lines.original: His eyes were rose in color and tears were forming on it........
lines.local: Uski aankhein laal/rose thi aur aansu bhar rahe the.

lines.original: Dhika: Suddenly falling on her knee... she held his chin up.... hey.... Chotu dear... what happened.... why are you crying ??? is something wrong ?
lines.local: Dhika turant ghutnon par baithkar uski chin upar pakadti hai: Arre Chotu dear, kya hua? Ro kyun rahe ho? Koi baat ho gayi?

lines.original: Chotu kept silent but kept looking at her.......
lines.local: Chotu chup raha, bas use dekhta raha.

lines.original: Dhika pushed the things that were in his hands down, and pulled him up...... grabbing his hands... she took him to the sofa...
lines.local: Dhika ne uske haath ka samaan neeche rakhwaakar use uthaya, haath pakda aur sofa tak le aayi.

lines.original: Dhika: quietly she asked..... hey sweetie... are you all right.... what happened... please tell me..... (  she had no clue why he was crying)
lines.local: Dhika ne dheere se: Hey sweetie, theek toh ho? Kya hua? Please batao. Use bilkul pata nahi tha woh kyun ro raha tha.

lines.original: Chotu: last time.... last time didi... he weeped a litte....
lines.local: Chotu thoda sisak kar: Pichhli baar... pichhli baar didi...

lines.original: Dhika: feeling something.... oh dear.... is this regarding what happened here last time...... did I .... hurt you...
lines.local: Dhika ko andesha hua: Arre dear, yahan pichhli baar jo hua uske baare mein? Kya maine tumhe hurt kiya?
